Youngsters can recreate a classic Jurassic Park scene and play out their own stories with this collectible LEGO® Jurassic World Dilophosaurus Ambush (76958) toy building set. A cool gift for kids aged 6 and up, it features a Dilophosaurus figure and a buildable Jurassic Park Jeep® toy with a driver’s seat for the Dennis Nedry minifigure, plus muddy minifigure and dinosaur footprint decoration. There is also a small jungle build, including an ‘East Dock’ sign for the Jeep to knock over like in the movie and a Barbasol can element to inspire imaginative play. LEGO Builder
Let the LEGO Builder app guide your youngster on an intuitive building adventure, allowing them to zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track their progress. Dinosaur fun
LEGO Jurassic World sets feature molded, buildable dinosaur figures, minifigures and detailed vehicles that let kids relive scenes from the movies and animated series, play out original stories or just build and display the collectible models.

productName: Triceratops Research
description:
Kids who are into dinosaurs and cool cars will love this collectible LEGO® Jurassic World Triceratops Research (76959) playset. An awesome gift toy for ages 8 and up, it features an authentically detailed Jurassic Park Ford Explorer with an onboard navigation system element to track dinosaurs and space for the 2 minifigures – Dr. Ellie Sattler and Ian Malcolm. The set also includes a posable Triceratops, buildable pile of dinosaur poop with a toxic berry element inside and a shovel accessory, so children can play out the famous Jurassic Park scene that inspired the set. LEGO Builder
Kids can enjoy an easy and intuitive building adventure with the LEGO Builder app. Here they can zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track their progress. Dinosaur delight!
There are LEGO Jurassic World sets to excite fans of all ages, whether they want to recreate iconic scenes from the movies and animated series or simply build and display the collectible models.

productName: Brachiosaurus Discovery
description:
Capture the sense of awe that Dr. Ellie Sattler and Dr. Alan Grant felt when they first glimpsed a majestic Brachiosaurus, with this LEGO® Jurassic World Brachiosaurus Discovery (76960) playset for ages 9 and up. A super gift idea for Jurassic Park fans, it features a posable Brachiosaurus, the tallest LEGO dinosaur figure to date, plus a buildable toy Jeep® Wrangler and a tree. The Jeep has space for the 3 minifigures – Dr. Alan Grant, Dr. Ellie Sattler and John Hammond – and the tree has a viewing platform and detachable leaf elements to ‘feed’ to the Brachiosaurus, as Alan Grant did in the movie. A new way to build
Give your youngster an easy and intuitive building adventure with the LEGO Builder app. Here they can zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track their progress. Dinosaur fun
There are LEGO Jurassic World sets to excite fans of all ages, whether they want to recreate classic scenes from the movies and animated series or simply build and display the impressive models.

productName: Visitor Center: T. rex & Raptor Attack
description:
Relive dramatic Jurassic Park scenes with this collectible LEGO® brick-built Visitor Center: T. rex & Raptor Attack (76961) play-and-display set for ages 12 and up. The Visitor Center’s distinctive architecture is captured in LEGO style, and the entrance hall, kitchen/dining area and lab are divided by semi-transparent screens with dinosaur graphics. Place the buildable T. rex skeleton in the entrance hall and make the ‘When dinosaurs ruled the Earth’ banner fall down at the flick of a trigger during battles between the posable T. rex and Velociraptor toy figures. Unlimited play
A great gift idea for any Jurassic Park fan, the set includes 6 LEGO minifigures – Dr. Ellie Sattler, Dr. Alan Grant, Ray Arnold, Dr. Henry Wu, Lex Murphy and Tim Murphy – and lots of play-inspiring accessories. LEGO Builder
The LEGO Builder app offers a convenient way to keep instructions organized. Use the app to zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets, track progress and find inspiration for new builds.

productName: Heart Ornament
description: Inspire creativity in kids aged 9+ with this beautiful LEGO® Heart Ornament (40638) kit. Once built and customized, the heart can decorate a home or office for Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day or Father’s Day, or at any time. The set features 254 pieces, including a hanger element and extra accessories for customizing the heart. The building instructions and packaging include 2 images to inspire decorating. The ornament makes a meaningful gift for any number of seasonal occasions.

productName: Bird's Nest
description: Appeal to builders aged 9 and up with a fun gift to have in time for both spring and Easter – the LEGO® Bird’s Nest (40639) kit. The set has 232 pieces and features a nest with a flowering branch and space for a mama bird, 2 chicks and 3 Easter eggs. The birds and eggs can be removed, and all 3 birds have movable wings, making this a fun set for kids to display in different ways. Kids can also rearrange the flowers on the nest and branch as they celebrate the Easter holiday and spring itself!

productName: Money Tree
description: Encourage creativity with the LEGO® Money Tree (40648) building kit for kids, which lets boys and girls aged 9 and up celebrate Lunar New Year while assembling a beautiful piece of LEGO seasonal decor.Builders can immerse themselves in tradition as they create the money tree model and discover its awesome details. In Chinese culture it has long been believed that a money tree brings abundance, prosperity and good luck and, true to this belief, this LEGO tree is adorned with riches and rewardsincluding 20 tangerines, 14 red envelopes and 10 coins. Once it’s complete, the model becomes an eye-catching piece of Lunar New Year decor that can be displayed in any room or used as a table centerpiece.A thoughtful gift idea for kids, this building set is sure to delight everyone who celebrates the festival or would like to learn more about it.

productName: Piñata
description: Bring extra fun to a party with this brilliant LEGO® Piñata (40644) building kit for ages 8+. The traditional Mexican party game comes in the form of a colorful donkey with a posable head, neck, tail, legs and ears. The Piñata can be used to store small LEGO bricks to replicate candy inside it, which will fall out when opened at the bottom to the delight of kids and adults. This set makes a wonderful showpiece at any celebration and an attractive item for display.

productName: Land Rover Classic Defender
description: Celebrate the 75th anniversary of the Land Rover Series I by building this incredible classic Defender replica. This impressive model features many details from the real-life version, including the roof rack, headlights, Land Rover badge and side-view mirrors. Once the car toy is built, put it on display or place the driver minifigure behind the wheel to enjoy some high-speed role-play action!

productName: Tusken Raider
description: Star Wars™ fans can relive thrilling scenes on Tatooine as they build a LEGO® BrickHeadz™ Tusken Raider (40615) character. With authentic details such as the Star Wars: A New Hope outfit, plus a gaffi stick and blaster, it makes a cool anytime gift for fans aged 10 and up or any Star Wars collector. The brick-built character comes with a baseplate and will make a striking addition to any display of Star Wars construction toys.

productName: EVE & WALL•E
description: Captivate movie fans and kids aged 10+ with this iconic BrickHeadz™ set featuring Disney•Pixar’s EVE & WALL•E (40619) buildable LEGO® figures. Build each of the detailed models, then set them on their individual baseplates for display anywhere. The collectible set consists of 155 pieces to create the robots, plus a small plant element. WALL•E’s torso and eyes are decorated stickers. The set makes a fun holiday or birthday gift and display piece for kids or fans of Disney•Pixar’s WALL•E movie.

productName: Cruella & Maleficent
description: Thrill kids and movie fans aged 10+ with this BrickHeadz™ set featuring Disney’s iconic Cruella & Maleficent (40620) buildable LEGO® figures. Build each of the detailed models, then set them on their individual baseplates and display anywhere at home or in the office. The set consists of 320 pieces to create the 2 LEGO figures. Maleficent’s torso includes a decorated sticker. The set makes a collectible everyday gift and display piece for kids or fans of Disney’s Cruella and Maleficent movies.

productName: Moana & Merida
description: Inspire kids aged 10 and up with this BrickHeadz™ set featuring Disney’s Moana and Disney•Pixar’s Merida (40621) buildable LEGO® figures. Movie fans can build the detailed models, then set them on individual baseplates and display them anywhere at home or in the office. The set consists of 410 pieces to create the 2 LEGO figures. Moana’s skirt is decorated like in the movie. The set makes a fun birthday or holiday gift and collectible display piece for kids or fans of the movies.

productName: Heart Box
description: Bring color to the playtime of toddlers aged 18 months and up with the LEGO® DUPLO® Classic Heart Box (10909). As parents and toddlers build, play and build again, this imaginative learning toy kick-starts kids’ creative building and delivers developmental benefits that last a lifetime. Building toys for toddlersLittle hands can’t wait to get hold of the toddler-friendly bricks and start building. Simple instructions ensure the imaginative play starts without delay. There’s a house, ice cream, whale, flower, helicopter and a duck. Each easy-to-build model provides lots to talk about and imaginative stories to role-play. The creative fun continues as kids mix the bricks to build their own creations. Build valuable creative skillsLEGO DUPLO playsets put open-ended play and self-expression into the hands of budding builders. With recognizable settings, familiar characters and toddler-friendly bricks, they inspire preschoolers with a boundless enthusiasm for playful learning.

productName: Alphabet Town
description:
Looking for the best toy to help toddlers recognize their letters? The LEGO® DUPLO® Classic Alphabet Town (10935) learning toy comes with all the letters of the alphabet, a drivable car and girl, boy and pug figures for hours of creative play. This is an ideal first LEGO set that lets toddlers create and recreate unlimited fun, colorful buildings. Making learning fun
The opportunities for learning are limitless. Not only will toddlers start to recognize the alphabet and colors, but they’ll also be able to explore new and interesting shapes. With so many bricks included, they’ll love building the tallest tower they can… which, of course, they’ll delight in knocking down – only to rebuild it again! With relatable characters, impossible-to-ignore, brightly colored bricks and interesting features, LEGO DUPLO toy playsets let preschoolers build self-expression through hours of fun-filled creative play.

productName: Creative Color Fun
description:
If you’re looking for a playset that’s packed with creative possibilities, LEGO® Classic Creative Color Fun (11032) is bursting with art-and-craft inspiration for kids aged 5 and up. ‘Painting’ with bricks
With 1,500 LEGO bricks in lots of bright colors, this open-ended building toy provides exceptional creative play value and artistic inspiration. Clear picture guides show kids how to make fun models, such as an octopus, a rocket and a shoe. They are then encouraged to adapt their model using different colors and fun accessories, such as wheels and an assortment of eyes. With so many pieces in so many colors, kids soon start to get creative with their own ideas. For added digital fun, young builders can zoom in, rotate models in 3D and track their progress using the intuitive LEGO Builder app. Family fun
LEGO Classic 5+ toys put ideas and inspiration into kids’ hands and provide a perfect opportunity for adults to share building fun and developmental milestones with their children.

productName: Creative Fantasy Universe
description:
With 1,800 bricks and 3 magical realms, LEGO® Classic Creative Fantasy Universe (11033) is bursting with make-believe, medieval fun, captivating characters and mythical creatures. A brick bonanza for big imaginations
Kids aged 5 and up can create 3 enchanting realms using 1,800 bricks in a rainbow of colors, including gold, silver and opalescent elements. One bag of bricks lets children build a knight, a knight on horseback and a dragon sitting on a pile of gold. Another bag includes a buildable cloud castle, wizard, magical mushroom and a winged unicorn. More bags contain bricks for a smiling sea serpent, mermaid and a toy pirate ship complete with cannons, a skeleton, goblin and a frog. Wherever kids’ imaginations take them, printed and digital (via the LEGO Builder app) instructions get them started quickly. Great for all the family
LEGO Classic toys are filled with ideas and inspiration and let parents share building fun and developmental milestones with their kids.

productName: Birdhouse
description:
Kids aged 8 and up can play out exciting stories with this brilliantly detailed LEGO® Creator 3in1 Birdhouse (31143) building set. It features a birdhouse with an opening roof at the top of a stand and includes 5 colourful and posable toy birds to sit on its perches. Creative toys that inspire 3in1 fun
Kids will be thrilled to choose from 3 different buildable animal scenes with this LEGO 3in1 set. They can build a birdhouse with 5 birds, rebuild it into a hedgehog and squirrel sitting on apark bench or rebuild it into a beehive with 4 bees and honeycomb. A fun, digital experience for LEGO fans
Using the LEGO Builder app to zoom, rotate and visualize the model, the guided real-life building process helps younger builders bring their creation to life on their tablet or smartphone and gives them a rewarding sense of achievement.

productName: Heartlake City Bus
description:
Young builders ages 7 and up can enjoy lots of role-play action with this LEGO® Friends Heartlake City Bus (41759) toy set. The set comes with 3 mini-dolls, a buildable bus and a bus stop sign. After building the bus toy, kids can act out stories with the characters. Perhaps they’ll imagine how shy Paisley builds her confidence as she interacts with the bus driver and older passenger. Accessories add to the role-play opportunities and include a mobility scooter, a ramp, a pretend ‘electric’ charger for the bus, Paisley’s book, sunglasses and smartphone, an umbrella and a flower bouquet. Boost the fun
Discover an easy and intuitive building adventure with the LEGO Builder app. Here kids can zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track their progress. Meet the next generation of Heartlake City
Inspire kids to develop their passions as they explore the new world of LEGO Friends with its diverse cast of characters.

productName: Disney Duos
description:
Appeal to movie fans and kids aged 6 and up with this LEGO® ǀ Disney: Disney Duos (43226) set, which includes 4 pairs of iconic brick-built characters from classic movies. Each character is posable, and every pair comes with a connectable display stand featuring a Disney-100th-anniversary-decorated element. As they build, kids can enjoy an easy and intuitive adventure with the LEGO Builder app. They can zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track their progress. Favorite Disney characters
This premium set is packed with beloved companion character pairs, including Lumiere and Cogsworth from Disney’s Beauty and the Beast, Pua and Hei Hei from Moana, Nemo and Squirt from Finding Nemo and Meeko and Percy from Pocahontas. The set is perfect for display and will be something everyone talks about when they see it.

productName: Ariel's Treasure Chest
description:
Appeal to creative kids and Disney fans aged 6 and up with this LEGO® ǀ Disney Ariel’s Treasure Chest (43229) set. It features a chest with opening lid, opening drawers and spinning turntable, plus lots of thingamabobs. There’s also a Disney’s Ariel LEGO mini-doll figure with blue ‘diamond’ dress, Flounder and Sebastian LEGO animal figures and a DOTS bracelet with a variety of tiles for decorating. As they build, kids can enjoy an easy, intuitive adventure with the LEGO Builder app. They can zoom and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track progress. Treasure keeper
The chest helps boost children’s confidence in their building and decoration skills, and has hidden spaces for them to tuck their own treasures inside. The LEGO mini-doll figure is based on the upcoming live-action Disney’s The Little Mermaid movie and can be added to other Disney ‘diamond’ dress sets (sold separately) to expand the play. This premium buildable toy set will make a fun gift for kids to join the hottest trend.

productName: Peach's Garden Balloon Ride Expansion Set
description:
Add extra coin-collecting challenges and role-play fun to kids’ LEGO® Super Mario™ world with the Peach’s Garden Balloon Ride Expansion Set (71419). Players can explore the detailed garden with their interactive LEGO® Peach™, LEGO® Mario™ or LEGO® Luigi™ figure (not included) in the brick-built hot-air balloon. Cool features include a Blue Toad’s house with a Super Star Block in the chimney’s ‘smoke’, a fountain with a Coin Block, and clouds over Pom Pom to part with the balloon. (Note: the 71360, 71387 or 71403 Starter Course is required for interactive play.) Social fun
An awesome gift for kids aged 7 and up, this toy playset includes 4 Super Mario™ characters – Pom Pom, a Blue Toad, a Pink Yoshi and a Lava Bubble – and is ideal for solo or social play. Download the LEGO Super Mario app for building instructions. Unlimited creativity
This building toy is a great fit with Peach’s Castle Expansion Set (71408) and can be combined with all LEGO Super Mario sets to create unique levels.

productName: Larry's and Morton's Airships Expansion Set
description:
Take the LEGO® Super Mario™ action into the skies with Larry’s and Morton’s Airships Expansion Set (71427). It features brick-built versions of these 2 Koopalings’ airships. Place LEGO® Mario™, LEGO® Luigi™ or LEGO® Peach™ (figures not included) in the cockpits and ‘fly’ the airships to activate sound effects and fight a virtual cannon battle. Morton’s airship can also be opened up to create a battle zone in a LEGO Super Mario level. Note: the 71360, 71387 or 71403 Starter Course is required for interactive play. Iconic characters
This playset, which makes a fantastic gift for kids aged 8 and up, includes 3 LEGO Super Mario figures: Koopalings Larry and Morton, and a Goomba. Download the LEGO Super Mario app for building instructions, inspirational ideas and more to enhance the creative experience. Level up
Collectible toy LEGO Super Mario Starter Courses and Expansion Sets allow fans to expand, rebuild and customize their own unique levels for digital coin-collecting play.

productName: Nya's Water Dragon EVO
description:
Ninja fans aged 6+ play out gripping adventures in the air, in the sea or on the ground with Nya’s Water Dragon EVO (71800). The impressive LEGO® dragon features a posable head, jaw, legs and wings, plus a tail that can be used as a weapon. It also has a saddle for Nya to sit in, and it can be upgraded with golden elements to make it even bigger and stronger. Best ninja toys for kids
This fun-filled ninja playset features 3 cool minifigures: Nya, Lloyd and Bone Guard, who are all armed withimpressive and battle-ready weapons to inspire countless hours of imaginative play. When kids triumph alongside their ninja heroes and complete their mission, they are rewarded with a collectible Generosity banner. A fun digital experience for LEGO fans
Younger builders use the LEGO Builder app to zoom, rotate and visualize the model, and the guided real-life building process helps bring their creation to life on their tablet or smartphone and gives them a rewarding sense of achievement.

productName: Coruscant Guard Gunship
description:
Fans can take command of their own Star Wars: The Clone Wars missions with this LEGO® brick Coruscant Guard Gunship (75354). It features 2 pilot cockpits, 2 stud shooters, 2 adjustable cannons and a handle for flying. The rear hatch and sliding side panel give easy access to the cabin where there is space for troopers. A top Star Wars™ gift idea for kids aged 9 and up, the set also includes 5 LEGO minifigures, including Commander Fox, Chancellor Palpatine and Padmé Amidala, plus 3 blaster pistols and 2 blasters for action play. Digital instructions
Download the LEGO Builder app for an easy and intuitive creative experience. It offers step-by-step instructions, intuitive zoom and rotate tools to help kids visualize the real construction model as they build, and more. Cool building toys
The LEGO Group has been recreating iconic starships, vehicles, locations and characters from the Star Wars universe since 1999, and there is a huge variety of sets to delight fans of all ages.

productName: Ghost & Phantom II
description:
Fans can play out memorable Star Wars: Ahsoka scenes with these LEGO® brick versions of Ghost & Phantom II (75357) starships. The buildable Ghost model features 2 lever-activated spring-loaded shooters, a dual LEGO minifigure cockpit with a removable front section, and a cabin with 2 opening hatches, a detachable turret with a cannon (non-shooting) and space for a LEGO minifigure. The Phantom II shuttle has an opening minifigure cockpit and a storage compartment. There are also 5 Star Wars™ characters, including a General Hera Syndulla LEGO minifigure and a Chopper (C1-10P) LEGO droid figure. A new way to build
Add an extra dimension to the creative experience with the LEGO Builder app, featuring tools to zoom in and rotate 3D digital versions of the real-life construction models, track progress and save sets. Gift idea
This building toy makes an awesome gift for kids aged 10 and up and is part of a huge range of LEGO Star Wars sets that will excite Star Wars fans of all ages.

productName: Ant-Man Construction Figure
description:
Put the star of Marvel Studios’ Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania into the hands of kids aged 8+ with the LEGO® Marvel Ant-Man Construction Figure (76256). Standing over 9.5 in. (24 cm) tall, this fully jointed, buildable toy lets kids take Marvel movie action wherever they go. Iconic Marvel action hero
The fully articulated Ant-Man Construction Figure also comes with a microfigure of The Wasp, the Super Hero’s companion in the movie, who attaches to Ant-Man’s arm. When they’re not engaged in exciting adventures together, the authentically detailed figures look great on display. For added digital fun, kids can download the LEGO Builder app and step into a new world where they can zoom and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track their building progress.

productName: Diagon Alley: Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes
description:
Set the scene for hours of magical playtime fun with this colorful LEGO® Harry Potter™ Diagon Alley™: Weasleys’ Wizard Wheezes™ toy building set (76422) for ages 8 and up. It features connectible, brick-built models of the Weasley family’s joke shop and the Owl Post, which have instantly recognizable exterior details and can be turned around for easy access to interiors that are packed with play-inspiring accessories. The joke shop includes Puking Pastilles, Peruvian Instant Darkness Powder, Nosebleed Nougat and other decorated buildable boxes, while the Owl Post features a mail-drop function. Build, play, connect
The set includes 7 LEGO minifigures and an owl figure, plus Pygmy Puff, Fanged Frisbee and letter accessory elements, for kids to reenact movie scenes and play out their own spellbinding stories. LEGO Builder
Give your youngster an easy and intuitive building adventure with the LEGO Builder app. Here they can zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track theirprogress.

productName: Hogwarts Express Train Set with Hogsmeade Station
description:
Recreate the arrival of new Hogwarts™ students with the LEGO® Harry Potter™ Hogwarts Express™ & Hogsmeade™ Station (76423) toy playset for ages 8 and up. The new-for-June-2023 LEGO brick model of the Hogwarts Express features an engine, coal car, 2 passenger carriages and the Trolley Witch’s confectionery trolley. Drive the train on the tracks or rotate the engine’s front buffer beam for off-track journeys. Hogsmeade Station includes a ticket office, Owl Post, restroom and platform and has manyauthentic details to delight fans. Popular characters
An enchanting gift idea for kids, the set has 8 LEGO minifigures, including the first-ever minifigure of fan-favorite Lee Jordan, plus accessory elements such as a box of Bertie Bott’s Every Flavor Beans and the family photo album Hagrid™ gives Harry. A new way to build
Let the LEGO Builder app guide your youngster on an intuitive building adventure, allowing them to zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track their progress.

productName: Combo Race Pack
description:
Fans of the LEGO® 2KDRIVE video game and kids who love racing toys will enjoy the 6+ LEGO City Combo Race Pack (60395). This set comes with a red sports car, yellow SUV and a blue speedboat as featured in the game, with interchangeable front and rear modules for mix-and-match customization. Kids can play out hands-on 2KDRIVE action or stage their own epic races. Just add the 3 minifigure drivers and let the race begin! Digital building fun
Includes an easy-to-follow printed building guide and instructions in the LEGO Builder app. With this intuitive building companion, kids can zoom in and rotate and visualize models from all angles as they build. The app also enables them to track the building process and explore and save virtual playsets. Cool toys that put kids in the driving seat
LEGO City playsets put kids at the heart of the action. They get to decide the stories, with feature-rich structures, cool vehicles and inspiring characters that stimulate imaginative play withoutlimits.

productName: Modified Race Cars
description:
Here’s a cool playset for fans of toy race cars aged 6+. The LEGO® City Modified Race Cars (60396) set comes with 2 cars and attachable upgrades, including rocket boosters and propellers, as featured in the LEGO 2KDRIVE video game, plus interchangeable front and rear modules for quick mix-and-match customization. Kids can enjoy hands-on 2KDRIVE action, stage their own epic races and play out stories with the 2 driver minifigures. Interactive building guide
Includes an easy-to-follow printedbuilding guide and instructions in the LEGO Builder app, where kids can zoom in and rotate and visualize models from all angles as they build. The app also enables them to track the building process and explore and save virtual playsets. Toys that empower imaginative play
LEGO City playsets put kids at the heart of the action. They get to decide the stories, with feature-rich structures, cool vehicles and inspiring characters that stimulate imaginative play without limits.

productName: Monster Truck Race
description:
Fans of toy cars and the LEGO® 2KDRIVE video game can enjoy endless hours of fun with this 7+ LEGO City Monster Truck Race (60397) playset, including 2 funny monster trucks with cool functions, as featured in the game. Kids can enjoy hands-on 2KDRIVE ction or stage their own epic races between the taco and pirate driver minifigures. Interactive building experience
This set comes with an easy-to-follow pictorial building guide and step-by-step instructions in the LEGO Builder app. With thisintuitive building companion, kids can visualize models in 3D as they build. The app also enables them to track the building process and explore and save virtual playsets. Toys that put kids in the driving seat
LEGO City playsets put kids at the heart of the action. They get to decide the stories, with feature-rich structures, cool vehicles and inspiring characters that stimulate imaginative play without limits.

productName: Play with Braille - French
description: Give kids a fun building experience with this LEGO® Play with Braille – French set (40655) for kids with visual impairments who are learning braille. The set comes with baseplates to build on and there are play starters to explore on LEGO.com. The play starters help kids develop their skills as they learn how to orient, attach and stack the bricks. The set also gives an insight into the braille code and braille characters.

productName: Play with Braille - English
description: This LEGO® Play with Braille – English Alphabet set (40656) combines the fun of LEGO bricks with braille letters, numbers and signs to offer a playful learning experience for children learning braille. The set comes with baseplates to build on and there are play starters to explore on LEGO.com. The play starters help kids develop their skills as they learn how to orient, attach and stack the bricks. The set also gives an insight into the braille code and braille characters.

productName: Batman Key Chain
description: Inspire a young superhero wherever they go with this LEGO® DC Batman™ Key Chain (854235). It features a Batman minifigure on a durable metal chain and ring, which can be attached to keys, bags, backpacks and more. A great gift idea for kids aged 6+.

productName: Earth Blue 2x4 Key Chain
description: Fans of LEGO® sets will love the rare brick color used on the LEGO Earth Blue 2x4 Key Chain (854237). The 2x4 brick is attached to a durable metal chain and ring, which fastens easily and securely to keys, bags, backpacks and more. A great gift idea for kids aged 10+.

productName: Iron Man Key Chain
description: Fans of Marvel movies will love this LEGO® Marvel Iron Man Key Chain (854240). With a durable metal ring and chain attached to a minifigure of the armor-clad Avenger, it’s a great way for kids to bring Super Hero style to keys, bags, backpacks and more. A cool gift idea for kids aged 6+.

productName: Scarlet Witch Key Chain
description: Give a Marvel movie fan this LEGO® Marvel Scarlet Witch Key Chain (854241) to add Super Hero style to their keys, bags, backpacks and more. With a durable metal ring and chain attached to a minifigure of Wanda Maximoff’s alter ego, the Scarlet Witch, it’s a fun and practical gift idea for kids aged 6+.

productName: NINJAGO City Markets
description:
Kids aged 14+ and LEGO® collectors can experience the unique excitement and vibrancy of the place where the ninja live and play with this NINJAGO® City Markets (71799) building set. The detailed world of NINJAGO’s biggest ever model features 4 floors of shops, restaurants, offices and apartments, as well as a cable car, elevator, boat, bridge and even a flushable toilet. The ultimate NINJAGO set
There is something for NINJAGO fans old and young in this amazing set, including a bakery, a blacksmith’s, a general store, the Borg store, market stalls, a rooftop food court and a karaoke club with a pool table and stage. Kids can role-play action from the NINJAGO Dragons Rising TV series with 21 minifigures. The set includes many familiar faces like Lloyd, Nya, Zane, and Kai, as well as many never-before-seen fan favorites like Gayle Gossip, Blazey Hyper Speed, and Hounddog McBrag. A fun digital experience for LEGO builders
Let the LEGO Builder app guide you and your child on an easy and intuitive building adventure. Zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track your progress.

productName: Rey Plush
description: Children will feel like Resistance heroes when they team up with the LEGO® Star Wars™ Rey Plush. This soft fabric, up-scaled version of a Rey LEGO minifigure is an ideal travel companion on long journeys and will inspire young Star Wars fans to recreate their favorite scenes of Jedi Master Rey in action. The collectible Rey stuffed toy is durably constructed with flat feet, so she can stand upright and be displayed as room decor between playtime missions.

productName: Spinjitzu Brothers: Curse of the Cateye Jewel
description: Go back in time with a young Wu and Garmadon as they set out to become Spinjitzu Masters. In this illustrated 144-page book for kids, the Spinjitzu brothers are thrown into a world of exciting adventures. Discover whether they can learn the skills of Spinjitzu and if a mysterious ninja can bring them closer together or cause problems. Part of a new-for-June-2022 book series, Spinjitzu Brothers: Curse of the Cateye Jewel makes a fantastic gift for NINJAGO® fans.

productName: Spinjitzu Brothers: Lair of Tanabrax
description: Enjoy action-packed stories from when a young Wu and Garmadon were setting out to become Spinjitzu Masters. In this illustrated, 144-page, hardcover book for kids, the Spinjitzu brothers must prove themselves – but a mysterious puppet master may be pulling the strings and causing problems before they can begin their training. Can they work together as a team? Part of a new-for-June-2022 book series, Spinjitzu Brothers: Lair of Tanabrax makes a great gift for any passionate NINJAGO® fan.

productName: How to Be a Pirate
description: Inspire young children to be creative and courageous with LEGO® How to Be a Pirate. This 24-page, illustrated book tells the charming story of Cecilia whose dreams of becoming a pirate come true when she joins her grandfather’s pirate crew. Part of the new-for-2022 LEGO Little Golden Book series, LEGO How to Be a Pirate makes a terrific gift for young kids and any LEGO collector.

productName: 5 Minute Stories
description: Ninja fans will love this attractive book containing 10 stories about their heroes, which can each be read in 5 minutes or less. The action-packed stories are all about Cole, Kai, Zane and the rest of the crew as they learn their ninja skills and seek to protect NINJAGO® City from a cast of villains. This is the perfect gift for kids who enjoy a story at bedtime or any time!

productName: Book of Elemental Powers
description: This brilliant, 96-page, illustrated book provides kids with everything they need to know about mastering the art of Spinjitzu. It’s packed with knowledge and advice and is the perfect guide to show ninja fans how they can follow their heroes and be ready to battle villains and keep NINJAGO® City safe. This is an ideal gift for kids who enjoy a story at bedtime or at any time!

productName: Eggstra-Special Easter
description: Capture children’s imaginations with the charming LEGO® Eggstra-Special Easter storybook. This 32-page book tells the story of how Easter-loving Duncan’s dreams come true when the Easter Bunny asks him to help deliver eggs. Will a little confidence and some LEGO creativity get the job done? LEGO Eggstra-Special Easter makes a fantastic Easter gift or anytime treat for kids.

productName: LEGO City: LEGO World Heroes in Training
description: Kids get to join their favorite firefighters as they learn new skills and try out new equipment in LEGO® City: LEGO World Heroes in Training. This 24-page, full-color, illustrated storybook comes with 30 brick-tastic stickers and fun-packed adventures featuring popular characters from the LEGO City Adventures TV series – available on Nickelodeon, Netflix, and Amazon. A great book gift that will ignite the imagination of any budding everyday hero!

productName: Everything is Awesome
description: Search for hidden toys, pirates, ghosts and more in fantastic scenes based on classic LEGO® playsets in this colorful activity book. With its focus on the history of iconic LEGO brick toys, LEGO Everything is Awesome makes a great gift for young children and any LEGO collector.

productName: How to Be a Knight
description: Help kids to find the hero within themselves with LEGO® How to Be a Knight, part of the new-for-2022 LEGO Little Golden Book series. This delightful, 24-page, illustrated book tells the story of Milo who dreams of becoming a knight like his big, bold brothers. Will a dragon in distress help him find the courage and creativity to make his dreams come true? LEGO How to Be a Knight makes a fantastic gift for young kids and any LEGO collector.

productName: The Mandalorian Plush
description: Kids can feel like a member of the Bounty Hunters’ Guild with the collectible LEGO® Star Wars™ The Mandalorian Plush. This soft fabric, up-scaled version of The Mandalorian LEGO minifigure makes a cuddly travel companion and will inspire Star Wars: The Mandalorian fans to dream up their own stories of adventure in the galaxy’s Outer Rim. The Mandalorian is durably constructed with flat feet, enabling him to stand upright on shelves as room decor when not part of playtime action.

productName: R2-D2 Plush
description: Kids will love teaming up with a legendary droid when you give them the LEGO® Star Wars™ R2-D2 Plush. This soft fabric, up-scaled version of an R2-D2 LEGO droid figure is the perfect travel companion for youngsters and is sure to inspire memories of classic Star Wars saga scenes for every fan. The R2-D2 stuffed toy is solidly constructed with flat feet, so he can stand upright and become cool Star Wars room decor between playtime adventures.

productName: Ewok Plush
description: Fans of all ages will love the supercute LEGO® Star Wars™ Ewok Plush. This soft fabric, up-scaled version of an Ewok LEGO minifigure makes a cuddly travel companion and will inspire young Star Wars fans to recreate their favorite scenes of Ewoks in action on the forest moon of Endor. The collectible Ewok stuffed toy is durably constructed with flat feet, so it can stand upright and be displayed as room decor between playtime adventures.

productName: Yoda Holiday Plush
description: Feel the festive Force, you must, with the LEGO® Star Wars™ Yoda Holiday Plush. This collectible stuffed toy of a beloved character has a holiday sweater expressing festive cheer as only Yoda can. An awesome Christmas gift idea for kids, it’s sure to inspire them to do their best Yoda impersonations and play out Star Wars stories. Yoda’s sturdy construction and flat feet also enable him to stand upright on a shelf as cool Yule decor between playtime adventures.

productName: Stormtrooper Holiday Plush
description: Bring cheer to the Christmas season with the LEGO® Star Wars™ Stormtrooper Holiday Plush. This soft fabric, up-scaled version of a Stormtrooper LEGO minifigure is decorated with a festive Galactic Empire sweater and makes an ideal cuddly travel companion for kids on holiday outings. Great for cuddling and playing out Star Wars stories, the Stormtrooper’s sturdy construction and flat feet mean it can also stand upright as a striking holiday display piece.

productName: Darth Vader Holiday Plush
description: Discover the softer side of a Dark Lord this Christmas with the LEGO® Star Wars™ Darth Vader Holiday Plush. A fantastic collectible stuffed toy for kids, this soft fabric, up-scaled version of a Darth Vader LEGO minifigure is decorated with a festive Death Star sweater. When he is not being cuddled or used by children to play out Star Wars stories, Darth Vader’s sturdy construction and flat feet mean he can stand upright on a level surface as striking holiday decor.

productName: Chewbacca Holiday Plush
description: Get into the festive spirit with the LEGO® Star Wars™ Chewbacca Holiday Plush. This collectible stuffed toy of the towering shaggy giant of Kashyyyk has a Santa hat and a soft candy cane and is the ideal cuddly companion for a young Star Wars fan on Christmas outings to galaxies far, far away. The Wookiee’s sturdy construction and flat feet also enable him to stand upright as a holiday display piece between travels and playtimes.

productName: Harry Potter Plush
description: Spark children’s imaginations with the Harry Potter™ Plush. This soft fabric, up-scaled version of a Harry Potter LEGO® minifigure makes a cuddly travel companion and is sure to inspire magical memories of their favorite Hogwarts™ adventures. The collectible Harry Potter stuffed toy is sturdily constructed with flat feet, so he can stand upright and be displayed as striking room decor between playtimes.

productName: Hermione Granger Plush
description: Young Harry Potter™ fans will always have a smart, caring friend by their side with the Hermione Granger™ Plush. This soft fabric, up-scaled version of a Hermione Granger LEGO® minifigure makes a brilliant travel companion and will inspire youngsters to create their own stories of adventures at Hogwarts™. The collectible Hermione Granger stuffed toy is sturdily constructed with flat feet, so she can stand upright and be displayed as room decor between playtimes.

productName: Albus Dumbledore Plush
description: Harry Potter™ fans can join the wise Hogwarts™ headmaster in the Wizarding World with the Albus Dumbledore™ Plush. This soft fabric, up-scaled version of an Albus Dumbledore LEGO® minifigure is the perfect travel companion and will inspire youngsters to dream up their own Hogwarts adventure stories The collectible Albus Dumbledore stuffed toy is solidly constructed with flat feet, so he can stand upright and be displayed as room decor between playtimes.

productName: Lord Voldemort Plush
description: Get close to a powerful Dark Wizard with the LEGO® Harry Potter™ Lord Voldemort™ Plush. When he is not being cuddled or used by kids to play out Harry Potter stories, this soft fabric, up-scaled version of a Lord Voldemort LEGO minifigure can stand upright on a level surface as striking room decor.

productName: Ron Weasley Plush
description: Harry Potter™ fans of all ages will love the Ron Weasley™ Plush. This soft fabric, up-scaled version of a Ron Weasley LEGO® minifigure makes a cuddly travel companion and will inspire youngsters to recreate their favorite scenes involving the unlikely hero. This collectible stuffed toy is durably constructed with flat feet, so he can stand upright and be displayed as room decor between playtime adventures.

productName: Hedwig Plush
description: Kids can take care of Harry Potter’s snowy owl with the Hedwig™ Plush. This soft fabric, up-scaled version of a Hedwig LEGO® figure makes a cuddly travel companion and will inspire young Harry Potter™ fans to create their own stories of adventure at Hogwarts™. The collectible Hedwig stuffed toy is sturdily constructed with flat feet, so she can stand upright and be displayed as room decor between playtimes.

productName: Hagrid Plush
description: Kids can pretend to be a half-giant Hogwarts™ gamekeeper caring for magical creatures with the LEGO® Harry Potter™ Hagrid™ Plush. This soft fabric, up-scaled version of a Hagrid minifigure is an ideal travel companion for youngsters and is sure to inspire imaginative play. The Hagrid stuffed toy is solidly constructed with flat feet, so he can stand upright as eye-catching room decor between playtime adventures.

productName: Wooden Minifigure
description: Inspired by the first LEGO® toys handcrafted from wood by Ole Kirk Kristiansen, this 5X-standard-size minifigure in FSC-certified oak also features adjustable plastic hands. Perfect for birthdays or special occasions, the model is presented in a gift box with enough LEGO bricks to build 5 items for the minifigure, plus a 28-page booklet that includes instructions as well as ideas and inspiration for LEGO enthusiasts, young or old.

productName: Minifigure Mission
description: Spark children’s imaginations with LEGO® Minifigure Mission. This 128-page activity book comes with a Charlie minifigure and accessories, and it invites kids to use their own LEGO bricks and building skills to help him find his way back from the bathroom to the safety of the toy shelf. The book is packed with building tips and inspirational photos to help youngsters as they create a bridge to traverse the kitchen sink, construct a roller coaster to distract the hallway monsters and much more.

productName: LEGO Ideas Book Second Edition
description: Check out the LEGO® Ideas Book Second Edition for more than 500 models and ideas for kids to create with their collection of LEGO bricks. The first edition sold over 2 million copies and the new edition brings more inspiration to passionate LEGO builders. This richly illustrated, 200-page, hardcover book is packed with tips from expert builders and divided into 6 ideas sections: transport, buildings, space, kingdoms, adventure and useful makes.

productName: Asha's Cottage
description:
Captivate kids aged 7 and up with Asha’s home from Walt Disney Animation Studios’ upcoming film, Wish, in this LEGO® ǀ Disney Asha’s Cottage (43231) construction playset. Inside is a 2-level building with hinged, opening sides, a table with a smiley-face cake, cabinets with a notebook, spoon and fork, and a bedroom upstairs with a bed and fireplace. There’s also a wishing well and loads of other play accessories. Add this LEGO ǀ Disney buildable set to others in the series (43223 and 43224, sold separately) to expand the play. As they build, kids get easy and intuitive assistance with the LEGO Builder app. They can zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track their progress. Unique cottage and characters
The set includes 4 characters – Asha, her mom Sakina, her grandpa Sabino and Star – to encourage role play as kids explore the cottage. Fulfill a child’s passion for magic and wishes with a buildable model that’s easy to take out for playdates and makes a fun gift.

productName: Dobby the House-Elf
description:
Delight Harry Potter™ fans with the first-ever LEGO® brick model of Dobby™ the House-Elf. The instantly recognizable brick-built figure has a posable head for different looks, and posable arms and fingers so Dobby can hold the included iconic accessories. There is a detailed buildable model of Harry Potter’s sock with Tom Riddle’s diary that Harry used to set Dobby free and Aunt Petunia’s ‘floating’ pudding cake to inspire memories of classic scenes. Collectible build-and-display model
A magical gift idea for kids aged 8 and up and any collector of Harry Potter memorabilia, this buildable Dobby the House-Elf display model stands over 7.5 in. (19 cm) tall. Place the Dobby figure on the buildable stand with a nameplate to complete a display piece that’s sure to catch the eye of every passerby. A new way to build
Give your youngster an easy and intuitive building adventure with the LEGO Builder app. Here they can zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track their progress.

productName: Igloo Holiday Adventure
description:
Kids ages 8 and up can create endless stories with this fun-filled LEGO® Friends Igloo Holiday Adventure (41760) toy. First, kids can build the toy igloo glamping dome and icy scene. Then they can role-play different stories as Paisley, her little sister Ella and friend Aliya relax in the mountain landscape. It’s the perfect opportunity for hardworking Aliya and shy Paisley to unwind together as they watch Ella play with the 2 sled dogs. The dome opens so kids can explore the cozy interior. There’s also a seating area, fairy lights, fire pit and steam pool to explore for more snowy role-play stories. Boost the fun
Kids discover an easy and intuitive building adventure with the LEGO Builder app. Here they can zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track their progress. Welcome to the next generation of Heartlake City
Kids can make friends, discover exciting locations and act out real-life adventures in the LEGO Friends universe.

productName: Darth Vader Mech
description:
Introduce youngsters to the dark side of the LEGO® Star Wars™ universe with this brick-built Darth Vader Mech (75368) for play and display. The posable mech has an opening cockpit for the Darth Vader LEGO minifigure, a clip for his lightsaber and gripping hands to hold a huge red lightsaber. A new way to build
A great anytime gift for kids aged 6 and up, this LEGO Star Wars mech is designed to be easy to build so the action play starts fast. Enhance the creative experience with the LEGO Builder app, which features 3D zoom and rotate viewing tools and allows builders to track their progress and save sets. Collectible building toy
This awesome buildable mech toy is part of a series of LEGO Star Wars mechs, which also includes the 75369 Boba Fett Mech and 75370 Stormtrooper Mech sets (sold separately).

productName: Boba Fett Mech
description:
Give kids a thrilling introduction to LEGO® Star Wars™ building sets with this Boba Fett Mech (75369) for play and display. The posable mech suit has an opening cockpit for the Boba Fett LEGO minifigure, a clip for his blaster rifle, gripping hands to hold the large stud-shooting blaster and a large jetpack with a flick shooter for action play. The Boba Fett LEGO minifigure has his own jetpack, which he can wear in the mech cockpit. A helping hand
A super anytime gift for kids aged 6 and up, this LEGO Star Wars mech is designed to be easy to build so the action play starts fast. Enhance their creative experience with the LEGO Builder app, which features intuitive building instructions, 3D zoom and rotate viewing tools and other fun stuff. Collectible building toy
This awesome buildable toy playset is part of a series of LEGO Star Wars mechs, which also includes the 75368 Darth Vader Mech and 75370 Stormtrooper Mech sets (sold separately).

productName: Stormtrooper Mech
description:
Give young kids an exciting introduction to the brick-built LEGO® Star Wars™ universe with this Stormtrooper Mech (75370) for play and display. The posable mech suit has an opening cockpit for the Stormtrooper LEGO minifigure, a clip for his blaster and gripping hands to hold the large stud-shooting blaster. LEGO Builder
An awesome anytime gift for kids aged 6 and up, this LEGO Star Wars mech is designed to be easy to build so the action play starts fast. Enhance their creative experience with the LEGO Builder app, which features intuitive building instructions with 3D zoom and rotate viewing tools and allows them to track their progress and save sets. Collectible LEGO Star Wars building toy
This mech model building kit is part of a series of LEGO Star Wars mechs, which also includes the 75368 Darth Vader Mech and 75369 Boba Fett Mech sets (sold separately).

productName: 5-Minute LEGO Builds
description: Kids will be thrilled to discover what they can create with this fantastic 5-Minute LEGO® Builds book. They will be spoilt for choice with over 100 fast ideas, including exclusive mini models, puzzles, games and challenges. There is also a basic kit of 50 LEGO bricks to get the fun started right away. This interactive, 96-page, hardcover book will help kids develop their creative sides and fuel their imaginations as they follow the step-by-step building instructions.

productName: Exotic Pink Parrot
description:
Little builders and passionate animal fans aged 7+ can travel deep into the rainforest for action-packed stories with this LEGO® Creator 3in1 Exotic Pink Parrot (31144) building set. It features a vivid pink and blue parrot that can fully rotate its body while sitting on a tree branch and move its wings and tail. 3in1 toys kick-start creative fun
Kids can build 3 different exotic animal toys with this fantastic LEGO 3in1 set. They can build a brightly colored parrot sitting on a tree branch, rebuild it into a playful fish swimming at the bottom of the sea or make a cheeky frog that can move its legs. A fun digital experience for LEGO fans
Download the LEGO Builder app and step into a new world of building fun where kids can zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track their progress.

productName: 100 Ways to Rebuild the World
description: Encourage children to be courageous, curious, caring and optimistic with LEGO® 100 Ways to Rebuild the World. This illustrated book features 100 fun, practical ideas for kids to make life better and more colorful, brick by brick. Plant bee-friendly flowers and build LEGO bees to spread the message; make a LEGO thank-you card for a neighbor; or create a LEGO emoji to make a friend smile… How will your youngster rebuild the world? The choice is theirs!

productName: LEGO Nutcracker
description: Celebrate the holiday season with the LEGO® Nutcracker (40640) building set. This LEGO interpretation of the iconic Nutcracker figure can be built with a male or female face and comes with movable arms and an opening mouth. A fun gift idea and an enjoyable build for kids, friends and families, this festive figure will bring a seasonal charm to any home or workplace.

productName: Harry Potter & Cho Chang
description: Fans can relive epic Quidditch™ games as they build these LEGO® BrickHeadz™ Harry Potter™ & Cho Chang (40616) figures. With authentic details such as the Gryffindor™ and Ravenclaw™ house Quidditch uniforms, plus Golden Snitch™ and broomstick accessory elements, the buildable duo make a magical anytime LEGO gift for kids aged 10 and up and any Harry Potter collector.

productName: Draco Malfoy & Cedric Diggory
description: Spark memories of dramatic Quidditch™ games for Harry Potter™ fans with these LEGO® BrickHeadz™ Draco Malfoy™ & Cedric Diggory (40617) figures. The brick-built characters are dressed in the Slytherin™ and Hufflepuff™ house uniforms they wear for Quidditch games. An inspirational LEGO gift for kids aged 10 and up, the set includes a house cup and 2 broomstick accessory elements to complete a spellbinding display.

productName: Miles "Tails" Prower
description: Sweet-natured Tails is a favorite character from the Sonic the Hedgehog™ universe. Now fans of the two-tailed fox can celebrate Tails’ genius and loyalty with this LEGO® BrickHeadz™ Miles "Tails" Prower (40628) set. The building kit includes a baseplate so kids aged 10 and up can create a fun display piece for their desks or gaming stations.

productName: Icons of Play
description: Inspire any soccer fan aged 12 and up with this LEGO® Icons of Play (40634) buildable toy set, featuring half a soccer field with a goal and VAR station, stands with a scoreboard, a ceremonial stage and more. Some of the 15 minifigures represent famous soccer players like crafty and creative Megan Rapinoe, the multi-talented Yūki Nagasato, world-class striker Sam Kerr and global superstar Asisat Oshoala. A fun gift idea for soccer lovers to build, play with and display.

productName: Dream Village
description: Let kids aged 7+ explore a magical setting from the LEGO® DREAMZzz™ TV show with this exciting Dream Village (40657) building toy set. A fantastical location frequently visited by the heroes during their sleep, the village is home to an array of dream creatures and charming businesses such as the magic shop, bakery and blacksmith’s workshop. Kids can choose to play out a shopping scene or rearrange the included modules to create a defense tower to prepare for Grimspawn attacks!

productName: Jurassic World Activity Landscape Box
description: Inspire children to create their own exciting adventure stories with the LEGO® Jurassic World Activity Landscape Box. It includes an activity book, a dinosaur trivia book and a 3D pop-up play scene, plus LEGO minifigures of dinosaur behavior expert Owen Grady and poacher Rainn Delacourt with accessories to play out epic showdowns. This boxful of fun makes a super gift for young Jurassic World fans and any kid who loves LEGO Jurassic World playsets.

productName: Build and Stick: NINJAGO Dragons
description: Ninja fans will be thrilled to build, customize and play out action with the 3 exclusive models that accompany this LEGO® Build and Stick: NINJAGO® Dragons activity book. There are 49 LEGO bricks for kids to build and rebuild into an Elemental Dragon, a Dragon Mech or an Evil Dragon, plus over 270 durable stickers for them to use to personalize their creations. The 48-page book features instructions, games, puzzles and coloring pages, letting kids enjoy countless hours of ninja action.

productName: 5-Minute Harry Potter Builds
description: Spark kids’ imaginations with LEGO® Harry Potter™ 5-Minute Harry Potter Builds. This magical 96-page book features over 100 mini-model building ideas and challenges. Each activity is designed to take no longer than 5 minutes, and kids can undertake them solo or share the fun with friends and family. With 65 LEGO bricks included to help children build, the book makes a fantastic gift for any youngster who is fascinated by the Wizarding World and LEGO Harry Potter playsets.

productName: Peter Pan & Wendy's Flight over London
description:
Sky-high adventures await Disney fans aged 10+ with this LEGO® ǀ Disney Peter Pan & Wendy’s Flight over London (43232) set. The detailed diorama depicts the iconic flying scene from the classic film, featuring London’s Big Ben with 3 glow-in-the-dark clockfaces, a cloud with stars and a glow-in-the-dark moon, a river with bridges and a doghouse. Also included are 3 LEGO ǀ Disney minifigures, a LEGO dog figure and a 100th Anniversary plaque. As they create, kids can enjoy an easy, intuitive building adventure with the LEGO Builder app, zoom in and rotate models in 3D, and track their progress. Iconic characters
Based on the classic Disney film Peter Pan, this set is made for play and display. It can inspire imaginative adventures and then take pride of place on a shelf once play is done. The set has 3 LEGO ǀ Disney minifigures: Disney’s Peter Pan, Wendy and Tinker Bell, plus a Nana LEGO dog figure, and can be a fun gift for adult fans or older kids who want to join the hottest trend.

productName: The Art of the Minifigure
description: LEGO® The Art of the Minifigure celebrates the history, design and global impact of the beloved LEGO minifigure over the course of the past 4 decades. This 144-page, richly illustrated book takes LEGO fans behind the scenes and shows how a minifigure evolves from initial sketches to the final product. There are also fascinating essays and interviews, beautiful photography, infographics and exclusive visuals from the archives on one of the most collectible toys in the world.

productName: Batmobile: Batman vs. The Joker Chase
description:
LEGO® DC Batmobile™: Batman™ vs. The Joker™ Chase (76224) puts Super Hero action with the iconic 1989 Batmobile into the hands of kids aged 8 and up. Batman adventures on wheels
This Batmobile playset brings all the drama and excitement of the classic 1989 movie to life. A lift-off roof provides access to the vehicle’s cockpit, with room for a minifigure in the driving seat. When kids turn a control on the side of the car, 2 built-in blasters rise into position. A flame element attached to the tailpipe revolves as the Batmobile moves, and a flip-open trunk provides storage space for the included Batarang™, harpoon spike and handcuffs. There are 2 minifigures – Batman and The Joker – plus accessories including a helmet and cape. For added digital fun, builders can zoom in, rotate models in 3D and track their progress using the fun, intuitive LEGO Builder app.

productName: Stop The Fire!
description: Kids ages 5+ can dive into hours of adventure with “LEGO® City: Stop the Fire!” This 32-page activity book is packed funny comic strips, exciting stories, fun activities, and challenging puzzles for them to enjoy. A super gift idea for fans of the LEGO City Adventures TV series, it also includes a minifigure of fire chief Freya McCloud and a buildable fire-fighting robot for action-packed role play.

productName: Go Extreme!
description: Get ready for a wild ride with Go Extreme! Based on the animated LEGO® City Adventures TV series, this 32-page activity book lets children explore the extreme sports of LEGO City with the included Dynamo Doug minifigure. Go Extreme! takes kids on an imaginative adventure where they skateboard through mazes, enjoy hilarious comic strip stories and much more. The book makes a super gift for young fans of LEGO building sets.

productName: Secret Coding Fun!
description: There’s endless imaginative fun to be enjoyed with the LEGO® DOTS: Secret Coding Fun! book. This 64-page, hardcover book includes all the instructions, inspiration and accessories kids need to create secret-message bracelets: 2 bangles, 36 DOTS tiles (with glow-in-the-dark, glitter and printed options), over 255 stickers, secret message note cards and 50-plus ideas for coding messages.

productName: Race Cars
description: LEGO® Race Cars will thrill and fascinate both car lovers and LEGO fans. The 64-page hardcover book is packed with incredible facts about some of the coolest, fastest and strangest cars to have ever been driven. For instance, did you know that there’s a car that runs on coffee? The book also comes with a buildable, high-quality 3-foot (36 in.) racetrack and 124 elements for kids to build and customize 10 cars. Once built, they can pit the cars against each other in exciting, action-packed races.

productName: How to Build LEGO Dinosaurs
description: Feed a child’s passion for dinosaurs and help them on their journey to become a better builder with How to Build LEGO® Dinosaurs. This 96-page, illustrated book features 30 LEGO dinosaurs, from an Ankylosaurus to a T. rex, and shows kids the essential building steps to recreate them with their own LEGO bricks. The models get more challenging through the book, developing your youngster’s confidence until they can build any dinosaur and even create their own imaginary prehistoric creatures.

productName: Heavy-Duty Bulldozer
description: Give young vehicle fans a treat with the LEGO® Technic™ Heavy-Duty Bulldozer (42163) set for kids aged 7+ who love construction toys. Inspired by real bulldozers, the yellow color scheme captures the imaginations of new Technic builders, encouraging boys and girls to develop new building skills. Authentic details include the tracks and the blade, which kids can lift and lower using the element on top of the bulldozer. This set makes a great gift idea for kids who love vehicles.  LEGO Technic construction sets feature realistic details that introduce young LEGO builders to engineering in an approachable way. Give kids a fun building adventure with the LEGO Builder app, which lets them zoom in and rotate models in 3D and track their progress.

productName: Green Race Car
description: The LEGO® City Green Race Car (60399) opens the door to a world of creative play for kids aged 4+. Prepare to cheer on your little racer and embrace the magic of playtime together with this LEGO racing car toy, featuring sporty tires and a cool rear spoiler. This set also includes photographer and racing driver minifigures, plus a winner’s trophy for imaginative storytelling.  This easy-build toy car playset makes a cool gift for kids aged 4+. It comes with a LEGO Starter Brick element, a pictorial guide and 3D instructions in the LEGO Builder app – a digital building companion with intuitive tools that enable kids to zoom in and rotate and visualize models from all angles as they build.  LEGO City playsets put kids at the heart of the action with realistic vehicles, detailed structures and inspiring characters for imaginative play without limits. Combine this vehicle toy with other sets (sold separately) from the LEGO City range for an open-ended world of play possibilities.

productName: Go-Karts and Race Drivers
description: Fans of race car toys can enjoy endless action with this LEGO® City Go-Karts and Race Drivers (60400) toy vehicle playset for kids aged 5 and up. Little racers can choose between 2 driver minifigures before playing out exciting competitions with the orange and turquoise mini go-karts.This toy go-kart racing set makes a fun gift for kids and includes an easy-to-follow printed building guide, with digital instructions available in the LEGO Builder app. Using this intuitive building companion, kids can zoom in and rotate sets in 3D to visualize models from all angles as they build. The app also lets them track their progress and explore and save virtual playsets.Children grow up surrounded by amazing vehicles and machines and with LEGO City building sets they explore them up close with realistic models and fun characters that inspire open-ended, imaginative play without limits.

productName: Construction Steamroller
description: Introducing the coolest toy steamroller in town! With its chunky tires and shiny rolling drum, the LEGO® City Construction Steamroller (60401) is perfect for fans of toy trucks and construction vehicles. Just like the real thing, it has a toy warning beacon and a cockpit for the driver minifigure. This fun toy will inspire creativity and imagination in children aged 5+ and can be combined with similar toys (sold separately) from the LEGO City range.  This toy steamroller isn’t just fun to play with. Kids also get a rewarding building experience with an easy-to-follow printed building guide, plus digital instructions in the LEGO Builder app. This intuitive building companion lets kids zoom in, rotate sets in 3D and visualize models from all angles as they build.  Kids grow up surrounded by amazing vehicles and machines, and with LEGO City Great Vehicles building sets they get to explore them up close with realistic models and fun characters that inspire imaginative play without limits.

productName: Blue Monster Truck
description: Looking for an engaging toy playset for kids aged 5+? The LEGO® City Blue Monster Truck (60402) is a great choice. This rugged off-road toy vehicle boasts huge rubber tires and a sturdy design that can handle action-packed play. Your child will have a blast zooming around and taking on daring jumps with an awesome toy that includes a driver minifigure for imaginative role play.  This toy monster truck isn’t just great to play with. Kids can enjoy a fun building experience with both a pictorial building guide and step-by-step digital instructions in the LEGO Builder app. With this intuitive building companion, kids can visualize models in 3D as they build, track the building process and explore and save virtual playsets.  Your City, No Limits! In LEGO City, kids create their own imaginative adventures whether they're soaring through the skies, racing around tracks, chasing crooks or fighting fires. Combine this set with others (sold separately) from the LEGO City range for even more fun.

productName: Emergency Ambulance and Snowboarder
description: Join your little builder for quality playtime with the LEGO® City Emergency Ambulance and Snowboarder (60403) playset, featuring a toy ambulance with chunky tires for off-road rescues. This fun set also includes a mini scene depicting a snow-covered skate park, plus snowboarder and paramedic minifigures for imaginative storytelling.  This easy-build rescue vehicle toy playset comes with a LEGO Starter Brick element, a pictorial guide and 3D instructions in the LEGO Builder app – a digital building companion with intuitive tools that enable kids to zoom in and rotate and visualize models from all angles as they build.  Your City, No Limits! LEGO City sets feature cool vehicles, realistic structures and fun characters that inspire open-ended imaginative play based on real-life events. Combine this emergency vehicle playset with others (sold separately) from the LEGO City range for a whole world of play possibilities.

productName: Burger Truck
description: This LEGO® City Burger Truck (60404) toy playset for ages 5 and up is a treat for young imaginations. Topped with a giant burger, the mobile fast-food joint can be detached from the truck and comes with a detailed food prep area, condiments and a service hatch that opens to display a flame-grilled burger sign. This set also includes a vendor minifigure and a customer minifigure with a cochlear implant.  You’ll find building instructions for the LEGO City Burger Truck toy in the box. Or you visit the LEGO Builder app where kids can explore and save sets, track their own building progress, and zoom and rotate to view models from all angles as they build.  LEGO City building sets put kids at the heart of the action with realistic models and fun characters that inspire open-ended imaginative play without limits. The sets make fun gifts and can be combined (other sets sold separately) for an open-ended world of play possibilities.

productName: Emergency Rescue Helicopter
description: Treat your everyday hero with the LEGO® City Emergency Rescue Helicopter (60405) playset. Designed for ages 6 and up, this set features a toy helicopter with a cool cockpit, spinnable rotors, an opening cargo bay and a working winch. Just add the hiker, pilot and rescuer minifigures, toy rescue flare and a sprinkle of imagination for hours of action-packed play.  Take your youngster on an exciting toy building adventure with the LEGO Builder app. Here they can explore and save sets, track their own building progress, and zoom and rotate to view models from all angles as they build.  LEGO City playsets come with realistic toy vehicles, detailed structures and inspiring characters for imaginative play without limits. Combine this fun set with others (sold separately) from the LEGO City Great Vehicles range for even bigger adventures.

productName: Race Car and Car Carrier Truck
description: Rev up the excitement with this LEGO® City Race Car and Car Carrier Truck (60406) playset, a perfect gift to fuel kids’ love for toy cars and trucks. Designed for ages 6 and up, this set features a race truck with a functional loading ramp and a cool race car with lowered suspension and flared fenders. The set also includes race driver and truck driver minifigures for role-playing fun stories and adventures.  This Race Car and Car Carrier Truck playset includes an easy-to-follow printed building guide and step-by-step 3D instructions in the LEGO Builder app. Here kids can zoom and rotate to visualize models from all angles as they build.  Kids grow up surrounded by amazing vehicles and machines, and with LEGO City Great Vehicles building sets they get to explore them up close, with realistic models and fun characters that inspire open-ended, imaginative play.

productName: Spaceship and Asteroid Discovery
description: Join your little astronaut for out-of-this-world adventures with this 4+ LEGO® City Spaceship and Asteroid Discovery (60429) playset, featuring a toy spaceship and 2 asteroid surface scenes depicting a laboratory and an excavation area with a crane. Just add the 2 space-crew minifigures, alien figure and crystal-rich meteorite for imaginative play and storytelling.  This easy-build space toy makes a fun gift for kids who love pretend play. It includes a LEGO Starter Brick element, a pictorial guide and 3D instructions in the LEGO Builder app – a digital building companion with intuitive tools that enable kids to zoom in and rotate and visualize models from all angles as they build.  LEGO City space-themed toys make a great gift for any occasion, with realistic vehicles, detailed structures and inspiring characters that merge fantasy and reality for imaginative play without limits. Kids can add this set to others (sold separately) in the LEGO City space range for more epic space action.

productName: Animal Train
description: Know a youngster who loves creative play and nature toys? Introduce toddlers aged 18 months and up to color-matching play with the LEGO® DUPLO® My First Animal Train (10412) set.  This preschool kids’ learning toy comes with 4 cute, buildable animals toys – a rooster, horse, lamb and cow – that transport toddlers on a journey of fun role play. Toddlers learn problem-solving skills as they follow the cards to construct the animals then match them to the colored train toy carriages. This vehicle toy also includes 2 extra bricks to let kids express their creativity as they build and rebuild the animals into toy figures of their own invention. Playful features, such as the rooster’s flexible neck and the toy train carriages that connect help hone a toddler’s motor skills.  LEGO DUPLO animal toys for toddlers put open-ended fun, self-expression and joyful exploration into young children’s hands while parents share their child’s precious developmental milestones.

productName: Caring for Bees & Beehives
description: Bring a buzz to playtimes with the LEGO® DUPLO® Caring for Bees & Beehives (10419) kids’ learning toy for ages 2 and up. This nature toy helps toddlers learn how to care for animals and nature and live sustainably.  This hands-on nature toy for kids comes with 2 cute bee figures, a beehive with a honeycomb brick, flower elements and a drivable truck. It teaches preschoolers that when they care for plants, bees get the food they need to make the honey we love to eat.  Toddlers practice fine motor skills as they build the toy flower stems to make them grow. They’ll have hours of role-play fun as they imagine the toy bees feeding on the nectar then returning to the beehive to make honey. This set also comes with 2 LEGO DUPLO figures – preschoolers help them to collect the honey, load it onto the toy truck and drive it to the market.  LEGO DUPLO development toy gifts let preschool kids share fun learning moments with their parents and caregivers.

productName: Alphabet Truck
description: Drive toddler’s letter-learning with the LEGO® DUPLO® Town Alphabet Truck (10421) construction toy for preschool kids.  This creative ABC toy delivers lots of playful learning. As toddlers connect the trailer with the toy truck and help the 2 LEGO DUPLO figures load and unload the bricks, they begin to recognize letters, learn colors, improve their language and hone fine motor skills.  Imaginative accessories include a LEGO DUPLO ABC book toy element and a stereo element to encourage fun ABC sing-alongs with parents and toddlers. This educational toy encourages toddlers to invent creative stories as they climb into their toy truck cab and head off for a new adventure!  Get toddlers off to great start with LEGO DUPLO construction toys, which put open-ended play, self-expression and learning into toddlers’ hands.

productName: Baby Dinosaur Rescue Center
description: Young fans aged 4+ can care for and play with dinosaur babies while learning to build with this LEGO® Jurassic World Baby Dinosaur Rescue Center (76963) set. It includes an off-road vehicle and research area with a cave wall, both with Starter Brick elements, plus a feeding station. 2 minifigures, baby Ankylosaurus, Triceratops and Velociraptor figures, and small Velociraptor and adult Pteranodon kids’ dinosaur toy figures get play started fast.  Picture instructions are included with this LEGO dinosaur toy for kids who are just learning to read. For added digital fun, the LEGO Builder app has intuitive zoom and rotate tools that help boys and girls see their model as they build.  LEGO Jurassic World 4+ sets introduce young kids to their favorite movie and TV characters and make a fun dinosaur LEGO set gift. They come with specially designed Starter Bricks, so even first-time builders can create vehicles, buildings and more with just a bit of help from an older sibling or adult.

productName: Flatbed Truck with Helicopter
description: Fast-paced adventures await boys and girls aged 7 and up with the LEGO® Creator Flatbed Truck with Helicopter (31146) playset. They can use the 3in1 set’s 270 pieces to build a cool transporter truck toy with moving wheels that can carry a LEGO helicopter with moving rotor blades on its trailer.  Kids can build 3 different vehicle toy sets containing 2 separate vehicles with this LEGO Creator 3in1 toy. They have the chance to build the Flatbed Truck with Helicopter, rebuild it into a propeller plane toy and fuel truck with moving wheels, make a hot rod and SUV toy car set for races, or use the bricks to create their own vehicles.  LEGO Creator 3in1 toys make great gifts for kids with 3 different models to create in every box. Kids will be excited to build, rebuild and build again. 3in1 sets keep them happy for countless hours and offer a range of models that appeal to their biggest passions, including superfast vehicles, amazing animals and detailed city scenes.

productName: Space Astronaut
description: LEGO® fans aged 9+ can blast into space to explore new planets by recreating space adventures with this LEGO Creator Space Astronaut (31152) building toy. The astronaut figure includes a detachable jet propulsion backpack, posable legs, feet, arms and fingers and a golden opening visor with a seat inside for a minifigure (not included).  Boys and girls can build 3 different space playsets: a posable space astronaut, a futuristic space dog with posable legs and tail, or a space viper jet with a se at for a minifigure (not included) to pilot it. All 3 models make great space-themed creative gifts and come with stands for display.  LEGO Creator 3in1 toys make great gifts for kids with 3 different models to create in every box. Kids will be excited to build, rebuild and build again. 3in1 sets keep them happy for countless hours and offer a range of models that appeal to their biggest passions, including superfast vehicles, amazing animals and detailed city scenes.

productName: Mobile Bakery Food Cart
description: Inspire creative play with the LEGO® Friends Mobile Bakery Food Cart (42606) playset for girls, boys and kids aged 6+. Kids who love role play can act out the story as Aliya visits the toy bakery cart with her pup Aira. The set includes 2 mini-dolls, a dog, a cart, a bakery mascot and accessories.  The accessories in this food playset for kids lets little ones create their own stories as they help Jules serve customers from the small toy vehicle. Accessories include a croissant, 2 macarons, cookies, a cookie container, coffee machine, coffee cup, hot chocolate and a cup of tea, plus a coin and a book for Aliya and a bone for Aira.  Discover more gift ideas for kids who love cooking toys in the LEGO Friends universe, where there are lots of opportunities for storytelling as kids act out real-life adventures. This set comes with the LEGO Builder app for an easy and intuitive building adventure. Here kids can zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track progress.

productName: Tiny Accessories Store
description: Give creative kids a treat with this LEGO® Friends Tiny Accessories Store (42608) building toy for girls, boys and kids aged 6 plus. Kids who love toy beauty shops will enjoy helping Paisley and Candi shop for a new fanny pack and hair accessories. Kids can act out the story as the characters use the mirror to check out their new look, then pay using their smartphones at the self-serve checkout. This playset makes a fun gift for 6-year-old and up girls, boys and kids. The set comes with LEGO Friends Paisley and Candi mini-dolls so play can start right away. Fun accessories include 2 fanny packs for the characters to wear. Discover a range of role-play toys for kids in the LEGO Friends universe, where young builders can enjoy creative play and act out real-life adventures. This small LEGO set comes with the LEGO Builder app for an easy and intuitive building adventure. Here kids can zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track progress.

productName: Heartlake City Hospital
description: Kids who enjoy medical play and doctor role play have lots to explore in this LEGO® Friends Heartlake City Hospital (42621) playset. This toy hospital set makes a role-play gift for girls, boys and kids aged 7 plus. It features different areas and wards reflecting the areas found in a real hospital, including an examination room, maternity unit, X-ray room and employee break room.  There are lots of stories to discover as Autumn arrives to have a new prosthetic arm fitted.
